title: Democrats win the Senate, setting up divided government for remainder of Trump's term
content: Democrats won by making inroads in several states where they have long struggled, boosted by a challenging political environment for the GOP dominated by voter frustration over high prices.

title: Democrat Josh Turek wins the Senate seat in Iowa
content: Democrat Josh Turek has defeated Sen. Ashley Hinson in Iowa, according to a race call by the Associated Press.

title: On a historic night for democratic socialists, Mamdani says midterms show power of working-class voters
content: The New York mayor tells NPR's Juana Summers that newly elected democratic socialists need to seize this moment and show voters what politics can deliver.

title: Democrat David Crowley will be Wisconsin's first Black governor
content: Democrat David Crowley defeated Republican Congressman Tom Tiffany in a campaign that focused on "lowering costs for working families" and bringing more jobs to Wisconsin.

title: Adam Hamilton becomes the first Democratic senator from Kansas in nearly a century
content: Democrat Adam Hamilton beat Sen. Roger Marshall, a fierce loyalist to President Trump, per a race call by the Associated Press.

title: Missourians reject ballot proposal that would have re-imposed an abortion ban
content: Missouri voters defeated a measure that would have banned abortion just two years after voters legalized abortion in another vote. Voters in Missouri legalized abortion two years ago but this time the abortion ban was coupled with a ban on transgender treatment for minors. Opponents said it was misleading.

title: Democrat Gina Hinojosa wins race for Texas governor, ousting Greg Abbott
content: Hinojosa, an Austin state representative, is set to be the state's first Democratic governor since 1995 and will be the state's first Latina governor.

title: Democrat Rob Sand wins Iowa governor's race, ending GOP control of the office
content: Democratic State Auditor Rob Sand stressed affordability and often talked about how his Christian faith guides him.

title: Missouri voters turn down a Republican-backed congressional map
content: Missouri voters have denied a Republican-backed congressional map that wound its way through the courts before ultimately ending up on the state's ballot.

title: Democrat Sherrod Brown wins Ohio Senate race
content: Democratic former U.S. Sen. Sherrod Brown has won back a seat on Capitol Hill, defeating incumbent Republican Sen. Jon Husted after a close and expensive battle, according to a race call by the Associated Press.
